description: A quiet moth with folded paper wings.
style: Flat paper with warm gray wings and a terracotta accent.
identityLocks: Two dark oval eyes with the same spacing in every row.
The wings are attached, compact, and never hide the face in a frontal pose.
A single amber marking on its left wing makes this character asymmetric.

motion.idle: Blink and slightly flex the attached wings.
motion.jumping: Rise as a whole, then return to the same ground baseline.
motion.working: Lower the body and focus forward with small wing movements.
motion.look: Anchor the body and lead with a head turn before the wings follow.

assetRights: Record provenance and permitted distribution for each asset.
acceptance: Inspect all state GIFs and document behavior on each supported client.
